updates.note: Management stated they expect the working capital cycle to revert to their steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the working capital cycle to revert to our steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Reiterated target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by FY 2030.
updates.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.

updates.note: Reiterated FMEG EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.
updates.quote: progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.

updates.note: Reiterated EHV capacity coming on stream by end of this calendar year.
updates.quote: Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year.

updates.note: Reiterated capex guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.
updates.quote: in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.

updates.note: Reiterated FMEG growth target of 1.5x to 2x of market rate.
updates.quote: outpacing industry growth in line with our target of growing at 1.5x to 2x of market rate

new_promises.statement: We have proposed a dividend of INR 47 per share, resulting in a payout ratio of 27.2%.
new_promises.quote: we have proposed a dividend of INR 47 per share, resulting in a payout ratio of 27.2%.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: We plan to execute a planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years.
new_promises.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Achieve a 30% dividend payout ratio by financial year 2030.
new_promises.quote: achieving a 30% payout ratio by financial year 2030.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Annual sustainable operating margin for the EPC business is expected to remain in the mid- to high single digits over mid- to long term.
